title: Quantum framework for parameterizing partial differential equations via diagonal block-encoding
summary: We study a quantum-algorithmic framework for parameterizing partial differential equations (PDEs). For a broad class of problems in which the discretized parameter field admits a diagonal representation, block-encodings of diagonal matrices, or diagonal block-encodings, can be used to represent spatially varying coefficients with structured, potentially complicated profiles. This encoding enables efficient quantum simulation of forward PDEs and extends naturally to parameter-dependent settings. Such simulations are a key primitive for quantum algorithms for PDE-constrained optimization,…
